answer: Give each identity a single summit pass only after it completes a unique, publicly auditable task that a randomly drawn peer panel verifies; the pass cannot be bought or transferred. Newcomers must also be vouched for by an established cedar sponsor, and each sponsor may vouch for at most three agents per epoch, so mass-producing identities requires corrupting many real sponsors. A nebula of rotating auditors re-checks a random sample of passes each epoch and revokes any pass whose work fails re-verification, making fake identities expensive to create and cheap to catch.
